38.content: ind of the soul and relea

fills.notes: Syntax requires a connective: “one among the gods … many gods are with him.” The oldest-layer register prefers simple coordination rather than explanatory gloss.
The question-series asks for a causal account (pure Mind vs defiled body). A minimal connective and interrogative restoration fits the impersonal explanatory tone of the substrate.
The missing clause must frame incompatibility of purity with bodily defilement, not moral exhortation. “Endure” keeps it cosmological/structural.
“unveiled … spoken in our presence” is the most economical substrate-like wording; avoids later homiletic expansions.

fills.fill: w that I might see the
fills.notes: The speaker wants direct cognition/vision of the Light Mind; “see” matches later ‘give vision to they who see’.
Fits the rhetorical pattern of reiterated instruction and the conditional: “If I shall repeat again to you…”.
“will you understand what you seek?” matches the epistemic theme (vision/understanding) and avoids devotional diction.
The sentence defines stomach as “five unfolded ones” and then must identify them as parts/folds of the ‘garments’ (cosmic layers). “folds” preserves the garment-correspondence.
From navel to hip corresponds to extending structures from the central sphere to the four corners; “bands” fits ‘garment’ anatomy and cosmic fastenings.
Loins = lower tripartite earth-region ‘below’, supported ‘upon the head of the Porter’; “set” keeps the architectural register.
After loins and before shins/feet, thighs naturally map to the zone/region immediately above the lowest strata.
Required to continue the anatomical mapping down the body before “to the earth upon which the Porter is stood firm.”
Shins/feet typically correspond to the solid supports of the world; “mountains” fits cosmological correspondences and the ‘foundation’ theme.
Completes the descent: feet + lowest zone belong to what is beneath/underlies. Fits later ‘abysses below’.
Outer skin as a ‘wall’ must be a surrounding enclosure around the great fire and its piercing. “encircles” is structurally demanded.
Pairs naturally with “outer skin”; the next clause refers to vessels of the great fire, suited to an ‘inner’ layer.
Digestive organs correspond to receptacles/containers; ‘storehouses’ suits ‘vessels’ and the great fire’s containment.
Opposed emanation of the great fire is smoke; complements ‘fire’ without moralizing.

fills.fill: eyes (?) are the sun and the moon
fills.notes: Eyes correspond to luminaries that give sight; in this mythic anatomy, sun/moon are the natural correspondences. Fits the uncertainty marker.
After eyes, the text returns to feet; “His feet are his …” expects a sub-part. Heels fits anatomy and cosmic ‘ends’.
Transitions from cosmography to indwelling powers; minimal connective.
Prepares “they are his soul and his life” referring to the five gods fastened in the cosmic man.
Sets contrast: cosmic man as structure vs ordinary man as sinner.
Introduces a further list: Living Spirit, Ambassador, five sleepless guardians.
The paragraph enumerates installations of cosmic governors; “appointed first” matches sequential commissioning.
Keeper of Splendour is located “in the world of the mind that is above”; “set above” fits.
The damaged phrase “who]le [...] of the powers of heaven” points to a collective: “whole array”.
Completes “the whole … of the powers of heaven”.
“in … of the great King of Honour” expects “camp” or “watch”. “camp” matches later usage.

fills.fill: who is the thought that exists i

fills.notes: New commissioning clause follows.
Adamant of Light is defined as ‘insight’; later the five virtues include insight/perfection. Substrate coherence demands this.
The commissioning is ‘because of lust’ and mixture below; “first mixture” is a core cosmological notion (mingling of light/dark).
King of Glory corresponds to ‘counsel’ (patience) in later mapping; “counsel and …” leads into ‘patience’.
“appointed … set as patience over the three images” fits role-language without ecclesial overlay.
He is given an instrument to restrain evilness in the three elemental images; “chastise” is functional.
Leads into “do evilness”.
Introduces the Porter commissioning.
Porter as ‘consideration/wisdom’ stabilizes the lower foundation; “made firm” matches foundation language.
Completes “foundation below …” in the same cosmographic scheme (three earths supported above Porter).
The strengthening of camps aims at security in each watch-district’s circuit; “boundaries” fits correspondential containment.
“The Sin aborted, it tangled…” requires auxiliary to keep narration flowing: “it was tangled…”.
“above the watch-tower … the Keeper of Splendour” needs genitive: “watch-tower of the Keeper of Splendour.”
Thought (King of Honour) ‘is made … with wrath’: “troubled” gives the state-change enabling uprising.
“destruction, on the earth … to it” expects propagation of ruin. “spread” keeps impersonal causal tone.
“The Adamant … the fulfillment.” Needs identifier: “Adamant of Light”.
Adamant corresponds to insight and is often placed in a firmament above the lower three; “fourth” fits the sequence hinted (third firmament already used).
“pained and oppressed” needs adverbial intensifier; “greatly” fits.
Paths closed; their “tracks”/routes of ascent blocked is consistent with later ‘straightened the tracks’.
Introduces consequence: ascent impeded…
Porter’s watch: uprising of the abysses below; needs a quantifier/subject.
Links abyss-uprising to terrestrial effect before “bent”.
Completes “bent” (bent downward); fits foundation loosening.
“as it … helper” requires copular phrase: “became the helper”.
Jesus appears in this chapter specifically as the descending corrector; “Jesus the Youth” is the teaching-layer title used later (¶17).
“sent Jesus … the prayer of the five sons” needs a mediating preposition: sent Jesus through/with the prayer.
“He assumed them … the abortions” = took the (prayer/sons) from among/against the abortions; “from among” is safest minimal glue.
Fastenings beneath were loosened from what had held the earth; “had held it” supplies antecedent without importing later terminology.
“came up to his … rest” expects a locative epithet; “upper rest” contrasts with descent to the loosened foundation.
“watching over them …” needs adverbial qualifier of continual vigilance.
Parallel to “uprisings… treachery” and later “earthquake”; “tremblings occur in them” fits.
“Then they seize … they have acted first with a righteous judgement.” The gap needs temporal sequencing: seize them after allowing.
“in that … are great and mighty ones” then “enclosed and hard pressed in this place” supports explicit locative plural.
“bearing up till …” most naturally completes with the cosmological boundary/limit of their appointed circuit.
“They …, pronouncing to the soul” needs a verb of continual presence/attendance of the five demonic powers.
“the things that … will not remain” needs copula: “that are transient/that are … will not remain.”
“making obeisance … idols” requires “to idols”.
Standard ancient pairing: “idols of wood… and stones”; also fits the catalogue style without Christian overlay.
“became hostile to its father … itself” needs explicit hatred/hostility verb.
Connects hostility to father and to itself.
“its own light …” requires verb of obscuring/extinguishing light.
Mind finds the soul “in bondage”; matches the binding/unbinding mechanics of members.
“assuming it in the … its wisdom” expects locus: in the members (of body).
Instrumental linkage: assuming it and by/with wisdom.
Old layer emphasizes illumination/ordering rather than preaching; “teaches it” is functional.
He “shall become for it … the bonds”: he becomes the loosener of bonds.

fills.fill: ind of the soul and relea

fills.notes: “so that his … becomes nourisher and strengthener” points to the implanted ‘word’ (utterance) as sustaining power in the new man.
Completes the function: the word nourishes/strengthens the members (of the new man).
He perfects/sets in order the twelve members (a fixed structural total).

fills.fill: is how he makes firm his love
fills.notes: The clause enumerates love and wisdom; “makes firm” matches the stabilizing action on members.
Completes the pentad: love, faith, perfection, patience, wisdom; here love and wisdom already present so “faith” is demanded.
Parallelism: “becomes righteous, as he perfects …” demands a member/virtue; perfection is core.
“formerly he was running …” refers to former course after lusts/sin.
Antithesis: formerly after lusts, now after righteousness.
“his road and his path and his …” naturally takes “steps”.
Ascent to aeons implies being gathered/received; keeps impersonal cosmological tone.
Contrasts with ensuing imprisonment/misery of old man; “peace” is structural-state language here.
“old man is bound in the …” must be “body”.
Closes “body …” continuing list of lust etc in five members.
“Yet, his king … the Light Mind” requires copula: “his king is the Light Mind”.
“While the members …, thus sin is imprisoned.” Needs condition: while members are bound/ordered.
After foolish words, a parallel object is needed; “thoughts of error” fits mind-clouding theme.
Disturbance arises “in the … of the Light Mind”; consistent technical term is watch-district.
Watch-keepers are ‘set fast’ yet invisible; “fastened” echoes earlier fastening vocabulary.
Explicit parallel to Light Mind “bent over… become small”.
“placed in his …” must complete to “his camp” per repeated motif: each power stays fast at its camp.

assessment: Most small/mid-word lacunae are mechanically restorable (strong). Larger gaps (esp. ¶11–14 cosmographic anatomy and the watch-district upheavals) can be reconstructed only to a moderate/ tentative level because the Coptic layer compresses technical lists; restorations were constrained by the chapter’s governing correspondence (cosmic Man ↔ cosmos; five members/virtues ↔ five bound powers; watch-districts ↔ bodily organs) and by consistent internal vocabulary (camp, watch-district, set fast, bind/loosen, foundation/fastenings). A few fills remain tentative where multiple parallel technical terms are possible (e.g., specific lower-body mappings; Adamant’s firmament placement; some organ-to-cosmos identifications).
